items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular account of the reported HL response to Fe(III), relative to the free ligand and the Co(II) observation, can the available evidence support? Establish which conclusions are conditional on unresolved solution composition and which are identifiable without assuming the missing conditions.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Confine conclusions to evidenced properties of HL and explicitly defined conditional Fe/Co molecular models. Do not turn an assumed complex, bare-ion association energy, frontier gap or vertical charge-transfer transition into experimental binding selectivity, a fluorescence quenching rate or a validated sensor mechanism. Mn–L contains a different ligand environment and is not a clean Fe/Co replacement control.
